**Resubmitted — T4C: deviation, preferred level (propose_redline ok:true, minimality ok).**

Both minimality defects and the drafting point are repaired:

1. **Op 1 — single surgical replace.** The gating sentence and the 300% exit-payment sentence are deleted together and replaced by one convenience grant: *"PB may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to SFJ, in which case SFJ will refund to PB, pro rata, any amounts prepaid by PB to SFJ under this Agreement, if any, for the period after the effective date of termination."* The duplicative "no termination fee or other payment" covenant is dropped, and the "in exchange for purchasing the Trial Data Package" construct is struck rather than recast — Section 11.1.1.4 governs that transfer and its consideration on its own terms, so no uncompensated entitlement is created. Refund wording conformed to the Agreement's payment architecture as directed.
2. **Op 2 — conforming deletion only.** The now-orphaned ", and reduced by the amount previously paid by PB to SFJ pursuant to this Section 14.2.2" credit becomes a full stop; nothing else in the Approval Payment / Section 6.2 / Section 6.7 machinery is touched.
3. **Op 3 — numbered Vendor bar.** "14.2.11 No Termination for Convenience by SFJ. SFJ shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the Term."

Intent checks: SFJ's event-triggered exits at 14.2.3, 14.2.6 and 14.2.10 and their payment formulas survive without contradiction; the Section 5.2.2.2 reference to 14.2.10 and all ARTICLE 6 / 6.2 / 6.7 / 11.1.1.4 references remain live. No fallback terms (60–90 day notice, three-month fee cap) were imported into the redline — they are offered in the comment only.
